title: NAILS deactivate --json
description: Machine-readable deactivate envelope (contract version 2): exactly one document on stdout with schema_version, command, ok, and either data or error. It reports the outcome: a success is printed only once the soft-reboot back to the decoy (or the power-off) is enqueued, so a failure to prepare or enqueue it is the one document (ok false, exit 1) and never follows a success. The switch then stops every program of the hidden session, the reader included, so a reader stopped first may not read the success. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. A declined prompt, or Ctrl+C at it, is the shared cancel shape: an error with the code `cancelled`, no data, exit 130; once the way back has begun, a signal no longer stops it. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.

warnings.description: What the return does not put back, one sentence each, as a person reads them: where its last step finds no `ip` (iproute2), the policy-routing rules the session added, and that a virtual link it made or a MAC address it changed makes the machine power off instead of returning; where it finds no `nft` (nftables), the nftables tables the session added; where it finds no `iw` on a machine with a Wi-Fi interface, that a Wi-Fi interface the session added on the decoy's radios, the one iwd makes in place of the decoy's by default included, makes the machine power off instead; and each backend device in `backend_left_open`. Absent when there is nothing to say; a power-off has none.

backend_left_open.description: The hidden backend's device-mapper devices that could not be marked to close (no dmsetup, or it refused): they stay open after the switch, their key in RAM, until power-off. Absent when every device was marked.
